entries.1c4c7f757dfd8c1a: This is the group's only reportable segment, manufacturing, processing and selling stainless steel, heat-resistant steel and high-nickel alloy plates and strips, as well as forgings, stainless building materials, stainless steel pipes, stainless processed products and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥150,866 million; by region, Japan was ¥112,606 million, China ¥13,396 million and other regions ¥24,863 million.
entries.2340f6f4137a6096: Together with group companies, it manufactures, processes and sells forgings, stainless building materials, stainless steel pipes, stainless processed products and others.
